verdict: Organic visibility is softening across all three locations; paid channels remain dark.
narrative: Across Forte Precision Metals, Advance Grinding Services, and O'Hare Precision Metals, your combined Google Business Profile activity generated 360 total actions this period — all of it organic, with zero paid spend running across any channel. Advance Grinding and O'Hare saw sharp late-period declines in profile engagement (down 65% and 62% respectively in the last 7 days), while Forte held its momentum better with a 61% week-over-week gain earlier in the period, though its final three days also went quiet. A web and SEO root cause fix is now in motion, and lapsed outreach sequences have been launched this week to begin rebuilding contact with your prospect list. Over the next period, you should expect site reindexing to begin restoring organic search visibility, and the outreach sequences to produce the first measurable contact activity.

highlights.phrase: total Google Business Profile actions across all three locations in the last 28 days
organic search clicks for Advance Grinding Services this period — the strongest search footprint of the three entities
paid ad spend active across any channel this period — all measurable lead activity is organic only

watch_item.issue: Google Business Profile engagement collapsed in the final week across Advance Grinding and O'Hare, with zero actions recorded on the last two to three days for both — and two O'Hare profiles recorded no calls at all despite 351 combined impressions this period.
watch_item.fix: Profile call-to-action setup is being reviewed and corrected on the zero-call profiles, and the SEO root cause fix now in submission is expected to stabilize search visibility heading into October.
